source_selection.reason: The first listed ShakeMap product is treated as the primary package ShakeMap source to avoid ambiguity when multiple products are present.

criteria.name: Numeric anchors
criteria.description: Retrieves local values for shaking, depth, fault dimensions, ground-failure populations, hazard alert values, wave height, and precipitation means; uses event-level properties.mmi and products.shakemap[0].properties.maxpga as the primary ShakeMap source.

criteria.name: Component arithmetic
criteria.description: Computes S, G, R, T, and P with correct formula use and unit handling.

criteria.name: Final score
criteria.description: Computes C with the natural logarithm and rounds the result to three decimals.

criteria.name: Intermediate ledger
criteria.description: Shows the liquefaction-to-landslide, hazard, geometry, wave-depth, and precipitation terms clearly.

criteria.name: JSON precision
criteria.description: Returns the compact JSON object with consistent numeric precision.

provenance.source_selection_note: MMI is from event GeoJSON properties.mmi; PGA is from the first listed ShakeMap product properties.maxpga.
